name: CFO
note: Sanction up to three players of your choice who possess 6 or more items with 20 minutes each.

name: Chancellor
note: Remote access to the Senate per turn, but all costs are increased by 30 minutes. Two votes when trying to change government, a single vote when voting remain.

name: Time Keeper
note: Every turn, siphon 20 minutes from one player of your choice and/or 20 minutes from a second player of your choice.

name: Real Estate Officer
note: Every time a player visits the Job Centre, Hospital or Senate you can demand 20 minutes.

name: Stock Broker
note: Once per turn, steal 30 minutes from a player of your choice and gamble it on your movement roll: 1: -30 mins; 2: -10; 3: +10; 4: +20; 5: +30; 6: +40.

name: Chaos Creator
note: Roll the black die: 1. +5 to Horseman counter; 2. Time Virus EVERYONE; 3. Draw a Scenario Card; 4. Time Virus a player; 5. +1 heat to a player; 6. Steal 30 mins from players. The roll for the ability is also your movement roll.

name: Assassin
note: Once per turn, inflict 20 minutes bleeding effect on one player and 10 minutes on a different player of your choice.

name: Syndicate Leader
note: Sanction a player of your choice with +1 heat by rolling 4 or higher for movement (not affected by charms) on your turn.

name: Pimp
note: Steal a collectable from another player (of their choice) on your turn.

name: Doctor
note: The costs at the Hospital are doubled whilst you are in post for all opposition players. Draw three Hospital Items per turn.

name: Charity Commissioner
note: All opposition players pay 20 minutes per turn whilst you are in post. Once per turn, forgive +1 heat from a player of your choice at an agreed price.

name: Judge
note: You can overrule and decide any court case. Can accept bribes/make deals for a favourable outcome at an agreed price.
